The Books section has two kinds of material. The first group contains two rendered textbook collections. The second contains four provisional research-development manuscripts that share this navigation sidebar.

## Publication State

The four volume pages and their canonical LaTeX sources are **available** at the reviewed revision. Their notebook companions are **scaffolded**, meaning the file and tutorial title exist; that status does not establish numerical correctness, successful execution, dependency availability, or reproducibility. The pages are navigation and research material, not validated courses, comprehensive reference works, clinical guidance, coaching guidance, or software capability promises.

Use the Books and Textbooks sidebar to move between these pages. Individual chapter pages are indexed in [Article Index](../resources/articles.html).

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-card}
### The Physics of Golf

Golf-specific textbook chapters on mechanics, control-affine modeling, multibody dynamics, shaft behavior, impact, and motor control.

[Open The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html){.resource-link}
:::
::: {.resource-card}
### The Geometry of Motion

Mathematical and computational foundations for rigid-body dynamics, nonlinear control, biomechanics, neural control, and simulation.

:::
